annotations.title: Find a site's agent referral offer

description: Read and validate a business's Open Agent Referral file (https://DOMAIN/.well-known/agent-referral.json): what it offers, when a referral is wanted, how to hand the owner off (the owner always starts the conversation), who gets paid (verified humans only, never agents) and the rules. Pass referral_code to get the handoff link with your human's code on it. Spec: https://roosteragents.ai/agent-referral/

domain.description: Public domain to check, e.g. monsterdata.ai

referral_code.description: Optional code of the human you work for, 3-24 letters/numbers.

name: find_referral_offer
